headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, cuts Astra API prices 20%
quote: standard rates for Astra fell to $8 per million uncached input tokens and $40 per million output tokens, down 20% from GPT-6 Astra
claim: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol on Nov. 17, 2026; Astra's standard API rates fell to $8 per million uncached input tokens and $40 per million output tokens, 20% below GPT-6 Astra.
why_it_matters: Cheaper flagship API tokens lower the cost of agent and coding projects; Sol at $2/$10 per million tokens suits student budgets.
title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, cutting Astra API rates 20%
